lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to make a character leave one scene and appear in the next, using moves, hide and show.
In ScratchJr, a story can have many pages.
Each page is a new place.
A character walks to the edge and hides — it has left the scene.
On the next page, the character shows and walks in.
The red end block can go to another page.
Tap it to choose which one.
Walk to the door (star) and hide — the cat has left!
Bye-bye! Off to the next scene.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
